set.body:
Objective:
Prove that the Frame foundation is coherent, cross-platform, independently buildable, and ready for a controlled extraction from ScalaFIM. Incubation deliberately uses ScalaFIM naming; extraction may rename packages, artifacts, and the repository, but must not require an architectural rewrite.

Acceptance gate:
- Frame core and the reference interpreter import no ScalaFIM domain or Gale packages and have no build dependency on internal ScalaFIM modules, even though their incubating package/artifact names follow ScalaFIM conventions.
- A documented extraction rehearsal copies the modules into a standalone build, performs the planned mechanical namespace/artifact rename, and compiles without changing schemas, plans, execution contracts, or dependency direction.
- JVM and Scala.js compile and test gates cover storage, ownership, dynamic and typed APIs, relational semantics, normalization laws, local execution, FS2 streaming, and baseline IO.
- Compile-negative tests prove field lookup, operator typing, join collisions, and nullability propagation.
- Arrow-layout fixtures and interop roundtrips verify physical fidelity without treating Parquet decoding or matrix packing as zero-copy.
- Resource tests and allocator diagnostics show that batch streams, retained slices, failed actions, collection, and early termination close correctly.
- Runnable examples cover inspect dynamic data, promote to a named-tuple schema, filter, withColumn, group, inner/left join, explain, stream, collect, and write.
- Bench receipts characterize scan, filter/project fusion, grouped aggregation, join, UTF-8, slicing, allocation, and JVM/JS behavior without claiming production-engine parity.
- An OSI-approved license, contribution provenance, code of conduct, security/reporting posture, binary/source compatibility intent, and maintenance expectations are documented before extraction.
- The standalone project is prepared for an affiliate-first Typelevel conversation while retaining its existing coordinates until accepted. Organization hosting and org.typelevel coordinates are explicitly deferred to a future governance decision.
- README and architecture docs state what Frame owns, what adapters own, why the local interpreter exists, and what remains out of scope.

Out of foundation scope:
Parquet pushdown, DuckDB, Polars, Gale vectors/matrices, ScalaFIM neuroimaging features, Spark, hybrid plan segmentation, spill, statistical models, formula/design-matrix construction, and a pandas-scale convenience API.
set.title: Frame foundation 6: cross-platform laws, ecosystem readiness, and controlled extraction gate
